label: Whatever has the nine is INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2, from finite caused intellects
description: Let g have the nine; g is INFINITE_1 (one of the nine). Let x be an intellect whose being some other being causes. By the first premise x is not INFINITE_1; by the second, an intellect that is not INFINITE_1 does not comprehend the INFINITE_1 being g. Hence no caused intellect comprehends g, and g is INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2. Conditional consequence; both premises stay open, and the conclusion is INCOMPREHENSIBLE_2, not INCOMPREHENSIBLE_1.
